title: Is Fact-Checking Politically Neutral? Asymmetries in How U.S. Fact-Checking Organizations Pick Up False Statements Mentioning Political Elites
reasoning: The paper focuses on the political neutrality and partisan asymmetry of fact-checking organizations using empirical analysis and regression models. While it utilizes a 'moral emotions' lexicon to analyze sentiment (contempt, anger, disgust) as a proxy for out-group animosity, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious or ethical systems.
